text:
Maya (Growth): Quick sync — proposing an "ensemble" launch: small webinar, 3 social posts, and targeted free-credit drip for new signups. Want to coordinate messaging + inbound routing. Thoughts?
Devon (Creative): love the name. thinking of 2 creative hooks: "Build w/ Redwood" (practical) vs "Ship LLM features faster" (outcome).
Maya (Growth): agree. we should A/B those on launch posts. also plan a benchmark tweet-thread showing cost/latency improvements. short + visual.
Sanjay (Product): for the webinar, can we make it a "hands-on workshop" with a 30-min lab? that will help surface prompt templates and onboarding flow. attendees get immediate starter credit.
Elaine (Eng): routing note — if attendees register, we should tag them as "cohort:workshop-ensemble" and route to growth-sales when token usage > 1k within 7 days.
Maya (Growth): Perfect. quick draft for post copy — feel free to edit:
```
A: "Ship LLM features 2x faster with Redwood Inference — join our hands-on workshop + get starter credits. Signup: https://redwood.ai/workshop"
B: "Lower inference costs, improve latency. Live workshop: build + deploy an LLM feature with starter credits. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/workshop"
```
Devon (Creative): A is punchier for socials, B better for LinkedIn long-form. I can make an animated gif for A.
Sanjay (Product): plus a benchmark card — one graphic comparing per-token latency and cost vs baseline. we'll need vetted numbers from infra. @Elaine can you grab 99th percentile latency for the small model?
Elaine (Eng): grabbing numbers now. sending a quick snapshot in a sec.
ops-bot: Deploy analytics snapshot: webinar-reg-page v2 -> 42 signups in first 3h, CTR 3.4% :rocket:
Devon (Creative): Nice! Not bad for soft launch.
Maya (Growth): Routing rules proposal (keeps leads manageable):
```json
{
  "source": "workshop_form",
  "tags": ["cohort:workshop-ensemble","launch:ensemble-march"],
  "route_to": "growth-sales",
  "route_if": {"first_week_usage_tokens": ">=1000"}
}
```
Sanjay (Product): I'd add a fallback: if growth-sales reserved capacity exceeded, route to automated onboarding email + prompt pack.
Maya (Growth): Good call. Also want to experiment w/ timing of starter credit: immediate vs post-workshop. hypothesis: immediate boosts attendance but may reduce post-workshop activation. we should randomize in the signup flow.
Devon (Creative): For onboarding prompts, I'll propose 4 mini-templates targeted to 4 personas (chatbot, summarization, code assistant, customer support). Can drop samples later.
Elaine (Eng): To support randomized credit timing, we need a simple flag in the signup payload. sample: `credit_timing: [immediate, delayed]`. I can wire it up to the form.
Maya (Growth): Great. Metrics to track: registration -> attendance, attendance -> 7d token usage, 7d token usage -> 30d retention. primary KPI = % of registrants hitting >1k tokens in 7d. secondary = cost per activated user.
Devon (Creative): I'll prep two post variations + GIF + benchmark card. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Sanjay (Product): I'll own the workshop agenda + prompt templates.
Elaine (Eng): I'll add routing rule + credit flag to form, and share the 99p latency numbers.
Maya (Growth): Awesome. Action items pinned: Dev for assets, Sanjay for agenda & templates, Elaine for metrics + routing. will follow up with calendar invite for dry run. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
